placement_rule.instructions: Before every pair the operator places the cube by eye at a new spot in the forward workspace; no marks and no measurements. Do not reuse the same spot. The robot reports the realized point and decides: if the point is already in the 0.226-0.234 m band it grasps directly, otherwise it drives the base toward it and then grasps. A point too far or too wide to locate is moved a little closer by the operator. The measured point, not the operator intent, is the recorded site.

front_camera.note: The far bearing bounds follow the calibrated D435i far-field fan from the home pose. Its depth top-face cluster is used only to drive the base into the wrist band; the final grasp target is always the validated wrist measurement.

coverage.note: The radius/bearing bounds are a guide to where the robot can see the cube, not a gate. The operator does not measure; the realized point is recorded and its membership is reported descriptively.
